media.title: MGM Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's MGM/Hollywood years. Includes Polish and American press coverage, studio-era publicity, reviews, and contextual images from 1934–1938. SRC0041 is represented here as a Nasz Przegląd Ilustrowany 1934 clipped press image showing Kaper, not as a separate standalone Media record within this gallery.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s MGM years, combining documents, press items and contextual images.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual images relating to Bronisław Kaper’s early MGM years and Hollywood career in the mid-1930s.

media.title: Variety, 27 November 1935 — Last of the Pagans / Tahiti clipping
media.description: Press clipping from Variety (New York), 27 November 1935 — the Tahiti-related item from the same issue concerning Last of the Pagans. Digitized by Internet Archive / Media History Digital Library.
media.rightsNote: Checked 2026-06-30 against UPenn/Ockerbloom “First copyright renewals for periodicals,” based on Catalog of Copyright Entries data. Variety (weekly) has no issue renewals found in CCE or CPRS; the list notes separately renewed contributions only from 8 January 1947 onward. This clipping/advertisement is from Variety, 27 November 1935, so the issue layer can be treated as public domain in the U.S. Media History Digital Library / Internet Archive is the access route. Keep a general caution for any separately registered advertisement artwork, photograph, syndicated/reprinted material, or underlying song rights; the clipping image itself is treated here as a public-domain issue layer, not as clearance for the song “Love Song of Tahiti.”
media.publicCaption: Variety clipping from 27 November 1935 documenting Last of the Pagans and the “Tahiti” song context.
